name: SEED-Bench-images-captioned
description: A collection of images paired with human-written captions intended to evaluate image captioning and multimodal understanding. The benchmark measures a model's ability to generate descriptive, relevant captions for diverse images and is typically evaluated with automatic captioning metrics and human judgments. It is used within SEED-Bench workflows to compare captioning and multimodal generation quality.
reputation: Relatively new and primarily used within the SEED-Bench suite; not yet a broadly established community standard.
